# Brevi

> Brevi is a programming language for AI models to write. It reads like Python, compiles to Rust for native speed, and reports each error as one short JSON line with a suggested fix. On its benchmark, models finish tasks in Brevi with 5 to 21% fewer tokens than in Python, counting retries.

## Docs

- [Language guide](https://brevi-lang.org/guide.md): the whole language in one page, written for models. Read it once before writing Brevi.
- [Libraries](https://brevi-lang.org/libraries.md): using other .bv files, Rust crates (`use sha2 "0.10"` plus `rust fn`) and Python (`py fn`) from Brevi.
- [Agent skill](https://brevi-lang.org/skill.md): setup and the write, check, fix loop for coding agents.
- [Benchmarks](https://brevi-lang.org/bench.md): tokens per finished task against Python, with method and raw logs.

## Tools

- [Compiler source](https://github.com/ets-public/brevi): Apache-2.0, written in Rust.

## Optional

- [Full text](https://brevi-lang.org/llms-full.txt): the guide and the skill in one file.
